text:
oliver_sales: Hi team — opening RFI thread for Venari Health. They asked for a 3-week POC (Private VPC peering + optional air-gapped on-prem bundle), capability matrix comparing Hosted/Dedicated/Private, embedding throughput 90 QPS target, streaming SLA, and pricing tiers. They attached rfi_questions_v1.pdf.

mina_se: I can own the capability matrix + narrative. Quick clarifying Qs: do they need on-prem HSM day 1 or just KMS integration? Also they asked for a short note on reranking vs embeddings cost tradeoffs.

carlos_infra: On-prem HSM is optional. CloudHSM or customer-managed HSM (Thales/Entrust) supported. Air-gapped on-prem bundle possible but requires extra lead time (4-6 weeks for packaging and field ops). For 90 QPS embeddings, Reserved Dedicated 5xA10 with KV caching should be a good starting point; int8 quant can reduce to 3xA10 in many cases. I'll attach perf note.

mina_se: Good. Draft compact capability matrix for the RFI (will export to spreadsheet):

```
Requirement                    | Redwood Response                   | Notes
----------------------------- | -----------------------------------| -------------------------------------
Deployment modes              | Hosted, Dedicated, Private (VPC)    | Private = customer-controlled network
Air-gapped on-prem bundle     | Supported (extra lead time)         | Field ops + air-gap packaging
HSM/KMS                      | CloudHSM, Thales, Entrust, PKCS#11  | Attestations under NDA                
Embeddings throughput target  | 90 QPS achievable                   | ~5xA10 w/ batching & KV caching       
Reranking vs embeddings cost  | Rerank cheaper per-query but higher latency | Recommend hybrid: embed store + rerank for precision
Streaming (token) SLA        | 95th pct token latency targets      | SLA optional paid tier                 
Audit logs & retention       | Configurable (30/90/365)            | Extended retention add-on              
Attestations                 | SOC2, ISO27001 (NDA)                | FedRAMP status note available          
Rollouts                     | Canary/A-B, fallback policies       | Per-route model pinning                
```

mina_se: I'll add a row about "attestations available under NDA" and attach the spreadsheet.

oliver_sales: Venari legal specifically asked for: (1) HSM vendor attestation + KMS flow diagram, (2) example billing transition from POC to production, (3) SLA credit language for streaming latency, (4) sample SOW and acceptance criteria.

carlos_infra: Uploaded perf note and KMS flow diagram: venari_kms_flow_v1.png -> https://redwood.docs/attachments/1698805123/venari_kms_flow_v1.png ; venari_embed_bench_v1.txt -> https://redwood.docs/attachments/1698805123/venari_embed_bench_v1.txt

ops-bot: File uploaded by carlos_infra: venari_kms_flow_v1.png -> https://redwood.docs/attachments/1698805123/venari_kms_flow_v1.png

mina_se: Uploaded capmatrix draft: venari_capmatrix_draft.xlsx -> https://redwood.docs/attachments/1698805123/venari_capmatrix_draft.xlsx. Flagged open items: exact SLA wording (percentile & credit calc), egress peering limitations, and air-gap checklist.

tara_prod: For pricing: propose POC: 3-week reserved capacity at 45% off list (includes 12 hours SE support across POC), production tiers: volume bands for embeddings (0-5M / 5-20M / 20M+ vectors) with per-embed price declines, streaming billed per-token with optional low-latency surcharge for SLA. Include one-page billing transition example. I'll attach SOW + billing one-pager.

legal-bot: Venari wants NDA before we share cert artifacts. Legal recommends sending NDA template and flagging certs "NDA only." Also they asked for sample SLA credit formula; legal will review drafts.

oliver_sales: Action items: (1) @mina_se finalize capmatrix + narrative answers by EOD tomorrow, (2) @carlos_infra confirm HSM vendor attestation text and lead times + upload final KMS flow, (3) @tara_prod finalize pricing + SOW + billing transition one-pager, (4) Legal to send NDA template to Venari. I'll assemble and send once NDA is signed.

carlos_infra: Cert refs (to be shared under NDA): SOC2 Report ID: SOC2-2024-RED-045, ISO27001 Cert# ISO-RED-1199. HSM vendors: Thales Luna, AWS CloudHSM, Entrust. Note: we do not persist plaintext customer keys; cryptographic ops delegated to customer's HSM/KMS. Uploaded HSM attestation placeholder: venari_hsm_attest.txt -> https://redwood.docs/attachments/1698805123/venari_hsm_attest.txt

ops-bot: File uploaded by mina_se: venari_capmatrix_draft.xlsx -> https://redwood.docs/attachments/1698805123/venari_capmatrix_draft.xlsx

tara_prod: Uploaded SOW + billing example: venari_sow_billing_v1.pdf -> https://redwood.docs/attachments/1698805123/venari_sow_billing_v1.pdf. SOW includes milestones: week0 connectivity/kms, week1 baseline bench, week2 optimization (batching/quant), week3 acceptance and handoff. Acceptance tests: embedding recall >= 0.72 on customer eval + 95th pct token streaming latency < 220ms.

mina_se: Noted. I'll include hybrid recommendation: embed store for scale + small reranker to improve precision when needed (saves on model compute for high-QPS workloads). Also will add optional quant path for cost reduction.

oliver_sales: If Venari pushes FedRAMP evidence we'll escalate to GRC. Otherwise we'll proceed with NDA -> package. Thanks all. Closing thread.
